title: Reach 9/10 dedicated-hardware readiness

steps.title: Establish the scaled private-RAG benchmark
steps.contextCapsule: Build a reproducible, QVAC-backed corpus benchmark that records document count, ingest time, index size, memory use, recall@5, citation accuracy, and p50/p95 retrieval latency. Do not use mocks or cloud inference. Pass at >=90% recall@5 and >=90% citation accuracy within the <=32 GB main-device boundary.
steps.summary: Passed real QVAC scale benchmark: 1,000 documents, 100 queries, recall@5 98%, citation accuracy 98%, p50 25 ms, p95 35 ms, ingest 37,476 ms, 23,771,243-byte index, zero drops on 24 GB Mac mini.

steps.title: Prove one multimodal task with two specialist agents
steps.contextCapsule: Use the real web chat path and local QVAC models. One natural task must carry image-derived evidence, voice-derived text, and private-document context, delegate to at least two specialist agents, preserve authoritative tool results, and return one grounded parent synthesis. Record the chat and GoalRun traces.

contextSummary: Close the remaining proof gaps with four evidence gates: scaled RAG; one natural multimodal flow; one parent coordinating at least two specialist agents; and held-out base-versus-LoRA evaluation. Finish with a real physical-device, WAN-disabled run and a scored evidence manifest. Existing baseline: strict multi-tool matrix 30/30, real nested orchestration, encrypted two-Mac delegation, multimodal routes, and QVAC Fabric adapter.
